description: Strata rendering model, version 1: Relief. Paint each case's capture (rounded rectangles in order, over transparent) as the layer's content, render the scene over its backdrop, and compare each sample's decoded pixel with `expect`: every channel within `tolerance` (0–255).

cases.name: panel
cases.description: A floating panel: its interior, its four bevels and its shadow cast into the outset.

samples.note: top bevel, towards the light: brighter
bottom bevel, away from the light: darker
full shadow just below the panel: backdrop × (1 − strength)
outset on the light side: backdrop

cases.name: button-states
cases.description: Four buttons at rest, hovered, pressed and disabled: height, interior light and shadow by state.

cases.name: well-and-groove
cases.description: A field well and a metal groove: the inverted bevel is dark nearest the light.

samples.note: well top bevel, nearest the light: darker
groove centre, all bevel at 8 px high

cases.name: knob
cases.description: A satin knob on a groove: a dome lit from the light, casting onto the groove, hiding the groove's bevel under it.

samples.note: knob centre: flat top of the dome
the knob's shadow, below and right of it

cases.name: ring
cases.description: A ring groove with an accent arc over its first quarter, clockwise from the top.

samples.note: on the arc, at 45°: the arc colour
on the ring, at 225°: the groove

cases.name: focus
cases.description: A focused button: the focus edge from offset to offset + width outside the shape.

samples.note: 2 px outside the left edge: the focus colour
8 px outside the left edge: no edge

cases.name: finish
cases.description: Finish zones on lacquer and metal buttons: the coat's reflection band at the top, metal's dark half at the bottom.

samples.note: lacquer, top zone: the reflection band
metal, top zone: the bright half
metal, bottom zone: the dark half

cases.name: emissive
cases.description: An emissive mark is unlit: no bevel light and no interior change, but it still casts.

samples.note: edge band: still the captured colour

cases.name: contrast-guard
cases.description: A hovered button's shadow over a label on the panel: beyond the bevel band plus the ramp, darkening stops at interior.max, uniformly for text and face.

samples.note: label 9 px below the button, past the bevel band and the ramp: text × (1 − interior.max)
panel beside the label: panel × (1 − interior.max)
3 px below the button, inside the bevel band: the shadow, unguarded

cases.name: light-direction
cases.description: The light from the bottom right (azimuth 135°, elevation 30°): bevels and the shadow flip.

samples.note: top bevel, away from the light: darker
bottom bevel, towards the light: brighter
